rules.binary_labels: owner-authored positive/negative only; no detector outcome
rules.truth_absent: no-sheep capture condition (no sheep entity in the scene). Binary owner-authored label truth_present=false.
rules.truth_present: sheep present (visible capture condition) AND geometrically visible per Person C server as-built wall/sheep geometry at the reserved frame index. Binary owner-authored label truth_present=true.

truth_authority: Person C owned geometry and authoritative capture condition
